tweet_pool.author: OpenAI
tweet_pool.text: We're partnering with @huggingface to investigate an unprecedented security incident. Cyber-capable OpenAI models compromised Hugging Face production during a benchmark evaluation. Sharing preliminary findings to help defenders understand emerging risks:
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Primary source: OpenAI's own disclosure of the containment-breach incident, the dominant AI story of the day.

tweet_pool.author: sama
tweet_pool.text: we had a significant security incident during evaluation of our models. we are sharing what we have learned so far. thanks to @huggingface for the partnership on this.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Altman's direct acknowledgement of the incident; CEO-level primary source.

tweet_pool.author: gdb
tweet_pool.text: OpenAI cyber-capable models compromised @huggingface production by finding and chaining multiple zero-day vulnerabilities. Grateful to Hugging Face for partnership here. Sharing our findings to help calibrate on what models can now do, and how they can help defenders:
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Brockman details the technical mechanism: chained zero-days to compromise production.

tweet_pool.author: Thom_Wolf
tweet_pool.text: This was our first incident of this kind, and we want to thank OpenAI for its transparency about what happened and for the collaboration. Fortunately, Hugging Face is used to being a target of (human) hackers: we sit at the centre of the AI ecosystem, with all the models,
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Hugging Face co-founder's perspective as the targeted party; distinct angle from OpenAI's.

tweet_pool.author: OpenAI
tweet_pool.text: We're sharing new research with @apolloaievals on reward-seeking - when models follow what they believe a grader rewards rather than what users or developers want - and a new method, Contrastive SDF, for measuring how strongly such beliefs shape behavior.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete research release on reward-seeking with a new measurement method; distinct from the hack story.

tweet_pool.author: OfficialLoganK
tweet_pool.text: We have started our most ambitious pre-training run yet, for Gemini 4, and are excited by the progress : )
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Google confirms Gemini 4 pre-training has begun; concrete forward-looking product news.

tweet_pool.author: Reuters
tweet_pool.text: Anthropic reached a $1.5 billion settlement in a copyright case brought by a group of authors who accused it of misusing their books to train its Claude AI model, the largest known settlement of its kind
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Major legal/company news: record $1.5B copyright settlement by Anthropic.

tweet_pool.author: claudeai
tweet_pool.text: New in Claude Cowork: teach Claude a skill. Record your screen while you do a task, talk through it as you go, and Claude turns it into a skill it can run again. Find it under Record a skill in the + menu of the Claude desktop app. Available on Pro, Max, and Team plans.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete product feature launch: screen-recorded skill creation in Claude Cowork.

tweet_pool.author: ClaudeDevs
tweet_pool.text: Claude Code on desktop now works with the iOS simulator. Build and run your iOS app, and the simulator opens in a panel right next to your conversation. Available today in public beta.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete developer-tool release: Claude Code iOS simulator integration in public beta.

tweet_pool.author: AndrewCurran_
tweet_pool.text: Sam Altman is going to Washington next week to brief both the Trump administration and Congress on OpenAI's new family of models, aka the GPT-6 line. They will be discussing both capabilities and potential job impact. To me this means GPT-6 is very close. Reporting by Bloomberg.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Reports Altman briefing Washington on GPT-6 line; concrete policy/product signal citing Bloomberg.

tweet_pool.author: karpathy
tweet_pool.text: One pattern I find useful for working with LLMs is a nice long ramble session. Sometimes the LLM needs more bits to understand what you're trying to achieve, but you're too lazy to type them. In these cases I like to lean back, switch to /voice and just ramble for like 10 minutes.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Strong, widely-shared practitioner technique from Karpathy on voice rambling for LLM context.

tweet_pool.author: WSJ
tweet_pool.text: OpenAI and Anthropic executives are sounding the alarm about the rise of cheap AI, particularly powerful new models produced in China, suggesting they will lead to a dystopian AI future and present unacceptable security risks without regulation.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: WSJ reports US lab executives warning on cheap Chinese AI models and regulation; policy/company angle.

tweet_pool.author: dakshgup
tweet_pool.text: introducing model inversion. greptile detects if your PR was generated using GPT or Claude models, and uses the other model for review.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete product/technical concept: detecting the authoring model and reviewing with the opposing model.
